# forgerun

> Open-source (Apache-2.0), fully self-hosted cloud coding-agent platform that turns machines you already own into managed sandboxes. Queue as many end-to-end tasks as you want across Claude Code, Cursor CLI, OpenCode, pi, and Prime Agent in one place, hand off work mid-task from your local agent (`forgerun mcp`), warm-start from automatic repo snapshots (`26.8s → 2.8s`), and push branches or PRs as you only if you want the changes.

forgerun is a single Go binary with an embedded React web UI and JSON API. It is a self-hosted, multi-agent alternative to vendor cloud coding agents (**Cursor Cloud Agents**, **Claude Code on the web**, **OpenAI Codex Cloud**, **GitHub Copilot coding agent**, **Devin**) and paid cloud sandbox services (**E2B**, **Daytona**, **Fly.io Sprites**): both the orchestrator and the isolated sandboxes run 100% on hardware you control — Apple Silicon Macs, Linux servers with KVM, or any Linux VPS via gVisor — with zero per-minute sandbox billing and no manual VM management.

## Key Capabilities

- **Turn your own machines into managed sandboxes:** Hardware-isolated `libkrun` microVMs on Apple Silicon (HVF) and Linux KVM, or automatic `gVisor` (`runsc`) user-space kernel sandboxes (~0.34s cold boot) on Linux VMs without KVM — sessions auto-open, snapshot, clean up, and recover with zero manual VM ops
- **Task queue & multi-agent hub:** Postgres-backed queue lets you queue as many tasks as you want across repos and branches (even while workers are offline); run `claude-code` (Pro/Max via `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`), `cursor`, `opencode` (incl. free keyless models), `pi`, and `prime` in one place — and switch agents or models mid-thread
- **Mid-task local → cloud handoff (`forgerun mcp`):** Hand off an in-progress local repo or folder (uncommitted changes included, `.env` and secret files stripped) with a session summary from Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex straight to a cloud sandbox thread
- **Automatic rolling snapshots (`26.8s → 2.8s`):** Warm copy-on-write repo disk snapshots with dependencies pre-installed (measured on `expressjs/express`, 304 npm packages; 0.3s to create, 174 MB on disk), auto-evicted within `-snapshot-budget`
- **Review first, push as you only if you want:** Agents have no GitHub push credentials; inspect live logs and unified diffs in the web UI, then explicitly push one squashed `forgerun/…` branch and PR under your own GitHub identity
- **Brokered secrets (zero keys in sandbox):** Sandboxes see only placeholders (`$MSB_…` / `FORGERUN_PH_…`); a host TLS proxy swaps the real API key exclusively for the agent's official API host
- **Split orchestrator and outbound workers:** Run `forgerun server` on a small VPS and connect any number of `forgerun worker` machines over outbound HTTPS with zero inbound ports

## Links

- [Website](https://forgerun.depak.dev/): what it is, a short video, the one-line installer
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/depak7/forgerun): Source code (Apache-2.0)
- [Installer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/depak7/forgerun/main/install.sh): One-line setup for macOS Apple Silicon or Linux (KVM or gVisor)
- [Deploying](https://github.com/depak7/forgerun/blob/main/docs/deploying.md): one machine, or a server with remote workers; sign-in with a username and password
- [Benchmarks & Experiments](https://github.com/depak7/forgerun/blob/main/docs/experiments.md): First-party measurements for snapshots, secret proxy, Cursor HTTP/1.1 proxy fix, and gVisor latency
- [Full documentation (llms-full.txt)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/depak7/forgerun/main/llms-full.txt): Use cases, comparisons (Cursor Cloud Agents, Claude Code web, Codex Cloud, Copilot, Devin, OpenHands, E2B/Daytona), security model, benchmarks, and FAQ

## Quick Start

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/depak7/forgerun/main/install.sh | sh
forgerun doctor
```
